name: The Prophecy
description: A prophecy locked in a vault below Nido Sanctuary, foretelling that New Capenna will die when its Halo runs out.

timeline.summary: Kamiz confronts Lagrella in an illusory Mergino Fountain, and Lagrella reveals the Prophecy and that the Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
